q: Bring 8 Gnoll Paws to Captain Danuvin on Sentinel Hill.
Bring Grimbooze Thunderbrew 5 hops to complete his special brew.
Bring 5 Iron Pikes and 5 Iron Rivets to Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire.
Kill Bristlebacks in Brambleblade Ravine and bring 12 Bristleback Belts to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
Search the wreckage of The Flying Osprey in the Wetlands.
Bring 12 Tunnel Rat Ears to Mountaineer Kadrell in Thelsamar.
Kill 8 Wailing Ancestors and 8 Rotting Ancestors.
Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill Sarltooth and return to him with one of his talons once the task is fulfilled.
Krusk in Tarren Mill needs you to free Drull and Tog'thar from Durnholde Keep.
Kill 12 Syndicate Footpads and 8 Syndicate Thieves, then return to Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore.
Slay King Mukla and return to Princess Poobah with the Key to free her.
Deliver the Crown of Will to Sharlindra in the Undercity.
Protect Shakes O'Breen during the attack.
Acquire 15 Bloodscalp Ears and return them to Kebok in Booty Bay.
Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 7 Plainstrider Feathers and 7 pieces of Plainstrider Meat.
Consume the Water of the Seers in front of the tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village and follow the vision once it appears.
Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill Sarltooth and return to him with one of his talons once the task is fulfilled.
Slay Serena Bloodfeather and return her head to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.
Gather 5 Intact Raptor Horns from Sunscale Scytheclaws, and bring them to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
Find the hidden shrine and re-enchant Dartol's Rod.
Bring back 5 Strider Meat to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine.
Bring 12 Timberling Sprouts to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
Take the mysterious fossil to Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker in Darnassus.
Lar Prowltusk outside of Sen'jin Village wants you to destroy the 3 sets of Attack Plans held within Kolkar Crag.
Bring 1 Embossed Leather Gloves, 5 Embossed Leather Boots and 5 Embossed Leather Cloaks to Lotherias in Darnassus.
Speak to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.
In the Name of the Light
Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Raleigh the Devout in Southshore.
Bring 10 Twilight Pendants to Argent Guard Manados in Darnassus.
Watch and learn the Omosh Dance of Joy.
Mudcrush Durtfeet in northern Dustwallow wants 8 Mirefin Heads.
Show Tooga the way back to his wife, Torta.
Bring the Woodpaw Battle Plans to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants you to wait for a moment while he prepares the weapons.
Bring 8 Dentrium Power Stones and 8 An'Alleum Power Stones to Rigglefuzz in the Badlands.
Retrieve Tundra MacGrann's dried meats from the stolen meat locker in Old Icebeard's cave.
Set the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers on fire by using the Torch of Retribution inside each of the buildings.
Bring 6 Mithril Tubes, an Accurate Scope, and 2 Advanced Target Dummies to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.
Bring 6 Mithril Tubes, an Accurate Scope, and a 2 Advanced Target Dummies to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
Collect 4 Grizzled Scalps from Grizzled Thistle Bears to the south of Auberdine and place them in Buzzbox 525.
Bring the Bank Voucher to Idriana in the bank of Darnassus.
Bring the Bank Voucher to Karus in the bank of Orgrimmar.
Kill 10 Pterrordax and 15 Frenzied Pterrordax, then speak to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.

Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.
Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.

Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.
Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.

Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrat
Escort Kerlonian Evershade to Liladris Moonriver at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.
Recover the Sea Turtle Remains from the Skeletal Sea Turtle in the waters west of Auberdine, and then speak with Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde back in Auberdine.
Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.
Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.
Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.
Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance. Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.
Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.
Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
Place Karang's Banner on the Foulweald Totem Mound. Do not let the furbolgs destroy the banner. Defeat Chief Murgut and bring Murgut's Totem to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar.
Speak with Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar.
Speak with Greatfather Winter in Ironforge.
Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.
Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.
Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Lightspark at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
Claim your reward from Hydraxis' Coffer.
Return the book to its rightful owners.
Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Saltwater Snapjaw turtles. Return to him when you have completed this task.
Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover 10 Vessels of Tainted Blood from Jintha'alor. Return to Primal Torntusk when this task is complete.
Bring me thise things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
Paragons of Power: The Haruspex's Tunic
Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Tabard. Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale. You must also be Revered with Zandalar.
Return the Azure Key to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt.
Kill Morphaz in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar, and return his blood to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood. The entrance to the sunken temple can be found in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Bring a total of 6 Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in sunken temple.

Bring 7 Cenarion Combat Badges, 4 Cenarion Logistics Badges and 4 Cenarion Tactical Badges to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.

Plant the Demon Summoning Torch in the mouth of High Chief Winterfall's cave in the Winterfall furbolg village. Defeat the demon and retrieve the Essence of Xandivious for Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold.

Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of Rebirth, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Bring the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Amber Idols, 5 Ivory Scarabs and 5 Bronze Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
Take the Eye of C'Thun to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time.
Bring a Belt of Valor and a set of Gauntlets of Valor to Deliana in Ironforge.
Bring a Belt of Valor and a set of Gauntlets of Valor to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Bring a Dreadmist Belt and a set of Dreadmist Wraps to Deliana in Ironforge.
Bring a Dreadmist Belt and a set of Dreadmist Wraps to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.

Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Redemption Boots if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Boots, 12 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 2 Arcanite Bars and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.

Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Bonescythe Helmet if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Helmet, 15 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 8 Cured Rugged Hides, 1 Nexus Crystal and 75 gold pieces.

Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Frostfire Belt if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Belt, 8 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Arcane Crystals and 2 Mooncloth.
Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Frozen Runes, 12 Thorium Bars, 2 Arcanite Bars, 2 Essences of Water and 200 gold.
Touch the bonfires within Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, then speak to a Festival Loremaster within the capital cities.
Touch the bonfires within Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, then speak to a Festival Talespinner within the capital cities.
